title: Thick of It (KSI)
blurb: "In the thick of it, everybody knows..." KSI's hook became the internet's most-remixed piece of audio, spawning an entire genre where the lyrics get swapped for increasingly unhinged nonsense while the beat stays untouched. It endures because the instrumental is catchy enough to carry any words at all, so every new brainrot term gets its own version within days of arriving. The original is the foundation everything else is built on. Play it as a flex, as a bit, or as the opening statement of a rap battle nobody agreed to.
origin: From KSI's 'Thick of It', the internet's most-remixed hook.
